label: Virtual BMS (native CAN BMS)
info:
Virtual BMS for Victron DVCC.
Reads the real BMS cell data, computes granular CVL/CCL/DCL, and publishes them
through a virtual com.victronenergy.battery service. Select this virtual battery as
the *controlling BMS* in Settings -> DVCC. Keep conservative charge limits programmed
directly into the MPPTs and inverter/charger as the hardware failsafe.
Tune everything in the CONFIG function node.

name: VERSION 2 :: native CAN-bus BMS (Pylontech / BYD / Lynx ...)
info:
Source: a CAN-bus BMS that reports to the GX directly. It still appears as a
com.victronenergy.battery service, so the same topics apply -- BUT many CAN BMSes
publish only System/Max|MinCellVoltage, not every cell. The watchdog falls back to
SAFE mode if Max/MinCellVoltage never arrive. Confirm both update in the debug sidebar.
